title: Remove the self-comparison schemaVersion assertion and fix the stale '13' docstring in epic_27_test_infrastructure_test.dart

evidence.quote:
///   AC3 — `test/helpers/drift_memory.dart` provides `inMemoryDb()`
///         returning a fresh schema-v1 (current schemaVersion = 13)

test('createFakeFirestore(strictRules: true) honours request.auth.uid '

'fake_firebase_security_rules does not yet evaluate '
              'request.resource.data — see firestore_fake.dart header. '

why: `expect(db.schemaVersion, db.schemaVersion)` compares a value to itself — always true, verifying nothing about 'the current schemaVersion' as the enclosing test name claims. The file's own top-of-file docstring says 'current schemaVersion = 13'; the real value (lib/core/database/user/user_database.dart:159) is `32` — stale by roughly 19 migrations, suggesting the original pinned-number check was hollowed into a tautology at some point to dodge updating a hardcoded expectation on every schema bump.
recommendation: Delete the self-comparison line (the `greaterThanOrEqualTo(1)` check on the next line is a fine minimal sanity check on its own); fix or remove the stale '13' in the docstring.
acceptance_criteria: No self-comparison assertions remain in this test; the docstring's schemaVersion number matches reality or is removed.
mergedFrom: Rename the strict-rules 'honours request.auth.uid' test in epic_27_test_infrastructure_test.dart to match what it proves
